subject: GDPR follow-up: controller/processor mapping and SCC module preference — next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Linda Kramer <linda.kramer@finhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: GDPR follow-up: controller/processor mapping and SCC module preference — next steps

Hi Linda / FinHealth security team,

Thanks again for your time on today's demo — appreciated the clear context on your ingestion patterns and retention constraints. Per our call, wanted to capture the key GDPR/security items and propose next steps so we stay aligned.

Quick recap of what we heard from you: 
- FinHealth will act as the data controller for the workloads discussed.
- You need Redwood to operate as a data processor (will require standard Controller→Processor DPA plus SCCs).
- You want confirmation of Redwood's SOC 2 status and a completed vendor questionnaire before legal sign-off.

Questions / asks for you:
1) Please confirm the preferred SCC module pairing (controller→processor vs. any processor→processor clauses) — you mentioned EU/UK coverage; confirming both would be helpful.
2) Can you confirm the categories of personal data we will process (PII, health-adjacent metadata, logs) so Rishi can scope the DPA redline appropriately?
3) Are there any required contractual provisions beyond standard Processor obligations (e.g., specific subprocessor audit rights, data localization requirements, elevated incident notification SLAs)?

Next steps (proposed):
- I attached a copy of our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_template_v1.3.pdf) for your review. Please share any initial redlines or a mark-up by EOD Tue (21 Jul) if possible.
- Rishi (cc'd) will prepare a short note on SCC options and a recommended configuration once you confirm data categories.
- If helpful, we can kick off the vendor security questionnaire — I see you have an internal template; please send it over and we’ll fill it out.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_template_v1.3.pdf (DPA template)

If that timeline works, I’ll block 30 minutes for a contract/controls sync next week.

Best,
Sooj
--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Linda Kramer <linda.kramer@finhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinHealth Security Team <security@finhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: GDPR follow-up: controller/processor mapping and SCC module preference — next steps

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the concise recap. Confirming the items from our side below:

- Controller/Processor: FinHealth is the controller for the workload; Redwood will be the processor.
- SCC modules: We require EU Standard Contractual Clauses covering controller→processor flows (EU SCCs). We also need to ensure equivalent UK SCC coverage for UK-resident data — happy to accept a combined set as long as they cover both regimes.
- Data categories: PII (name, email), health-adjacent metadata (appointment types, anonymized outcome flags), and operational logs (IP, timestamps). No raw clinical records will be shared in this pilot.
- SOC 2: Please confirm current status — do you have SOC 2 Type II report available? If not, what compensating controls can you provide?

Attached is our initial vendor questionnaire in case you want to start (FinHealth_Vendor_Q_20260716.pdf). We'll also share our legal team's DPA expectations after internal review, but ideally we can use your template as the starting point.

Legal contact: Linda Kramer (linda.kramer@finhealth.com) – will lead contract-side work.

Looking forward to the DPA note from Rishi and your SOC 2 note. If we can get draft redlines by next Tuesday, that keeps us on schedule for an August pilot kickoff.

Regards,
Linda

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Linda Kramer <linda.kramer@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 10:36:00 -0400
Subject: Re: GDPR follow-up: controller/processor mapping and SCC module preference — next steps

Linda / Soojin — thanks, good context. A few quick items from legal to keep this moving: 

1) SCCs: We can provide the EU 2021 Controller→Processor clauses and an equivalent UK addendum (typical approach). Unless you require a non-standard clause, that should satisfy EU+UK coverage. Please confirm if you need additional local law addenda (e.g., Swiss, if you have Swiss subjects).

2) SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering our hosted platform (report dated Q1 2026). I will share a redacted copy once I confirm distribution rights; in the interim, we can provide an attestation and our current SOC controls mapping. Compensating controls can include on-demand audit rights, dedicated logging hooks, and a contractual incident SLA.

3) Data categories & scope: Please confirm whether any special category data (explicit health diagnoses) will be in scope. You noted "health-adjacent metadata" only — if that's accurate, we'll scope the DPA accordingly.

4) Subprocessors & localization: We will provide a current subprocessor list and commit to notice/consent mechanics in the DPA. If you require data residency guarantees, let us know specific regions so we can surface options (Dedicated/Private deployments may be needed).

Attached: DPA_redline_instructions.docx — quick guidance on typical redlines we see from enterprise partners and our preferred responses.

Timeline proposal: 
- Linda: confirm data categories + SCC/UK requirement by Mon 20 Jul.
- Rishi: provide SOC 2 redacted report + SCC recommendation by Tue 21 Jul.
- Soojin/Marissa: start populating your questionnaire responses by Wed 22 Jul.

If those timings look reasonable I’ll review any redlines within 3 business days of receipt.

Best,
Rishi
General Counsel (acting), Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Linda Kramer <linda.kramer@finhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: GDPR follow-up: controller/processor mapping and SCC module preference — next steps

Great — thanks everyone for the quick turn. Confirming action items so we have a single source of truth:

Agreed items:
- Role mapping: FinHealth = Controller; Redwood = Processor.
- SCCs: provide EU 2021 Controller→Processor SCCs + UK addendum (Rishi to deliver).
- SOC 2: Rishi to share redacted SOC 2 Type II report / controls mapping.

Owner action list & deadlines:
- Linda / FinHealth: confirm special category data scope (if any) by Mon 20 Jul; share any required localization constraints.
- Rishi (Legal): send SCC recommendation + redacted SOC 2 by Tue 21 Jul.
- Soojin / Marissa: complete FinHealth_Vendor_Q_20260716.pdf answers and return by Wed 22 Jul.
- All: target DPA mark-ups submitted by Tue 21 Jul to maintain August pilot kickoff.

I'll schedule a 30-minute contract & security sync after Rishi posts the SCC/SOC materials — tentative invite for Thu 23 Jul (will send once I hear back on availability).

If anything here doesn't reflect your expectations, flag it and I’ll update.

Thanks,
Sooj
